study_phase: initial frozen run on newly authored cases; no evaluation feedback used to generate or select cases
heldout_definition: Fresh case IDs and scenarios, no reused old cases. Authored after v1.2 design was known, by the same assistant; not independently curated or expert-reviewed. Logical mechanisms can overlap previous tests. No engine/model evaluations on these cases before freezing. No outcome-based retries or tuning.
